name: Cloudflare DNS
summary: Authoritative DNS on a global anycast network: free tier, full API, DDoS-resilient query resolution.
description: Cloudflare's authoritative DNS service translates domain names into IP addresses from a globally distributed anycast network, with fast propagation and DDoS mitigation at the resolution level. A free plan includes unmetered DDoS protection and a fully-featured API for Terraform and Ansible; paid plans cover businesses and enterprises, and internal DNS adds private zones and split-horizon resolution.
contains: free plan with fast authoritative DNS and unmetered DDoS protection
fully-featured API, used with Terraform and Ansible for infrastructure as code
paid plans: Pro $20/mo, Business $200/mo, Contract custom
internal DNS: private zones, split-horizon resolution, private name resolution for remote users
anycast answers from the data center closest to the user
runs on infrastructure that powers 1 in 5 sites on the Internet
